scope: Bounded cross-project real contrast-change source audit with source-version-matched fresh capture controls; no training, tuning or GPU.
word_policy: FROZEN. No editing, overwriting, copying as a new version, or invoking taskbook writers without explicit user request.

word_reference.archive_path: protocol/网页截图的细微变更分类｜实验任务书_v1.1.docx

candidate_cases.state: disabled/enabled native controls, light mode, pointer outside target
native controls and fieldset boundary, light mode, pointer outside target
Click upstream Switch theme button once to select earthly; source-supported UI action, no CSS/DOM injection

capture.browser: Existing installed Google Chrome, same binary/version for all captures
capture.independence: Fresh browser process and context for every counted image, no PNG reuse.
capture.version_rule: Use exact Git commit and first parent, verified original test HTML/CSS. Captured target states match between versions and repeats.
capture.region_rule: Capture original upstream action-controls fieldset only. Selector fixed before pixel results; do not move crop to optimize scores.
capture.network_policy: Only verified local HTML/CSS resources allowed. External images/media/iframes from unrelated demo sections blocked and explicitly excluded from evidence. Reject if captured fieldset contains external media or active style/script dependencies are missing.
capture.expected_assets: Simple index+simple.css; Sakura test+normalize.css+default CSS+earthly CSS. Record all requests, including fetch/xhr and failed requests; required asset responses must match source hashes.
capture.font_rule: Original stylesheet system fonts; document.fonts loaded; record computed fonts on target controls.
state_checks: Same target dimensions and document/element state across captures
Same active theme, focus and pointer policy
No active CSS transition/animation at screenshot; screenshot animations disabled

source_grouping.project_groups: Repository is minimum shared unit; all commits in a repo grouped.
source_grouping.fixture_families: Merge shared upstream test-page families, even across different repositories. Simple and Sakura both credit cbracco/html5-test-page; verify before declaring cross-source independence.

annotation_policy: Use source diffs plus pixels/computed target styles; keep contrast-change candidate or exclude mixed/no-visible states. No certified human gold labels inferred from commit titles.

must_have: At least3 independent project/fixture groups with visible source-verified changes
At least1 independently reviewed contrast change per retained group
Version/browser/viewport/font/state-matched independent repeat controls, complete target resource checks
A source-isolated development/confirmation assignment frozen before scoring
comparison_gate.if_fail: Do not run pixel/edge detector evaluation, choose thresholds, train, or use opened419. Pixel difference validation alone is source evidence, not a benchmark score.

excluded: No opened419,355,155 or72 controls for selection/tuning; prior runs unchanged. No synthetic CSS-property injection.
scope_limit: Original stylesheet test fixtures and real upstream changes are project-level evidence, not independent production websites.
